title: ReLoop E-Waste Analysis Model Output
description: Schema for the 8-field raw model output from Bedrock vision analysis.

item.description: Short name of the e-waste item.

battery_risk.description: Risk level associated with battery safety.

swollen_battery.description: True if the battery is swollen, bulged, or deformed.

repairable.description: True if the item can reasonably be repaired.

still_usable.description: True if the item powers on and functions without repair.

confidence.description: Model confidence in overall analysis between 0 and 1.
